metadata.description: Turn SQL DDL or design Markdown into a long-lived ER bundle (.erd.json) that drives an interactive web page. Preserves design semantics (color layers, data flows, design decisions) that Mermaid can't express.

plugins.name: er-bundle
plugins.description: Generate or update .erd.json bundles that conform to erd-bundle.schema.json. Use when the user wants a long-lived ER design artifact with color-coded layers, multiple diagram views, data-flow narratives, or design-decision logs — not a one-shot Mermaid snippet.
